group.passage:
If you stay in a bath or a swimming pool for a long time, you may notice that the skin on your fingers and toes becomes wrinkled. For many years, people thought this happened [[1]] the skin simply took in water and grew bigger.
In the 1930s, however, doctors noticed something strange. Fingers with damaged nerves did not wrinkle at all, even after a long time in water. This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change. When the skin gets wet, the nerves tell the tiny blood vessels under it to become [[3]]. As a result, there is less room under the skin, and the skin on top folds into small lines.
But why would the body do this? Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things. In one study, people were asked to move wet objects from one box to another. Those with wrinkled fingers finished the task more [[5]] than those with smooth fingers. Like the patterns on car tires, the wrinkles may help water flow away so that our fingers can hold on better.

1.explanation_zh: 空格後面是前面現象的「原因」：人們以前以為手指起皺，是「因為」皮膚吸了水、變大了。because 引導原因子句。
evidence: For many years, people thought this happened [[1]] the skin simply took in water and grew bigger.

option_notes_zh.A: although（雖然）：前後不是讓步關係，「雖然皮膚吸了水、變大了，手指還是起皺」說不通。
option_notes_zh.B: unless（除非）：表示條件，「除非皮膚吸水變大，否則就會起皺」和要說明的原因相反。
option_notes_zh.C: until（直到）：表示時間，「起皺一直發生，直到皮膚吸了水」不合理。

1.strategy_zh: 「人們以為某事發生＋___＋說明」：後半句在解釋前半句的現象，就是原因。
hints: 空格要填連接詞，連接兩個子句。
後半句「皮膚吸了水、變大了」是在解釋手指為什麼起皺。

2.explanation_zh: play a role in… 是固定搭配，意思是「在…中扮演角色、有影響」。前一句說神經受損的手指泡水也完全不會起皺，可見神經在這個變化中「扮演了角色」。
evidence: Fingers with damaged nerves did not wrinkle at all, even after a long time in water.
This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change.

option_notes_zh.A: trick（把戲）：play a trick 是「捉弄」，要說 play a trick on 人，不能接 in the change。
option_notes_zh.C: song（歌）：play a song 是「播放、演奏歌曲」，和神經、皮膚的變化無關。
option_notes_zh.D: game（遊戲）：play a game 是「玩遊戲」，神經不會在皮膚變化中「玩遊戲」。

2.strategy_zh: 看到 play a ___ in，先想到 play a role／part in（在…中扮演角色）。
hints: 空格要填名詞，前後是 play a ___ in the change。
前一句：神經受損的手指不會起皺。
神經在變化中「扮演角色」：play a role in。

3.explanation_zh: 下一句說結果是皮膚下面的空間變少（less room），所以神經是讓微血管變「小」：smaller。皮膚下的空間變少，上面的皮膚就折成一條條細紋。
evidence: When the skin gets wet, the nerves tell the tiny blood vessels under it to become [[3]].
As a result, there is less room under the skin, and the skin on top folds into small lines.

option_notes_zh.A: wider（更寬的）：只讀本句說得通（神經讓血管變寬），但下一句 As a result, there is less room under the skin, and the skin on top folds into small lines. 說皮膚下的空間變少；血管變寬會讓空間變多，方向相反。
option_notes_zh.B: louder（更大聲的）：血管不會發出聲音，說不通。
option_notes_zh.D: funnier（更好笑的）：血管不會好笑，說不通。

3.strategy_zh: As a result 前後是因果：從結果「空間變少」回推血管的變化。
hints: 空格要填形容詞比較級，描述血管的變化。
下一句：As a result, there is less room under the skin。
空間變少是因為血管變「小」：smaller。

4.explanation_zh: 下一句說研究讓受試者把濕的東西從一個盒子移到另一個盒子，最後一句也說皺紋讓手指抓得更牢，所以科學家認為皺紋能幫我們「拿起」濕的東西：pick up。
evidence: Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things.
In one study, people were asked to move wet objects from one box to another.

option_notes_zh.B: write down（寫下）：「皺紋幫我們寫下濕的東西」說不通，東西不能被「寫下來」。
option_notes_zh.C: turn off（關掉）：turn off 用在電燈、機器，濕的東西不能「關掉」。
option_notes_zh.D: look like（看起來像）：「皺紋幫我們看起來像濕的東西」說不通。

4.strategy_zh: help＋人＋V：皺紋幫我們「對濕的東西做什麼」？用下一句的實驗內容確認。
hints: 空格要填片語動詞，受詞是 wet things。
下一句：實驗要人把濕的東西從一個盒子移到另一個盒子。
皺紋幫我們「拿起」濕東西：pick up。

5.explanation_zh: 前面說科學家認為皺紋能幫我們拿濕的東西，最後一句也說皺紋讓手指抓得更牢；所以手指起皺的人完成任務「更有效率」：more efficiently。
evidence: Those with wrinkled fingers finished the task more [[5]] than those with smooth fingers.
Like the patterns on car tires, the wrinkles may help water flow away so that our fingers can hold on better.

option_notes_zh.A: slowly（慢慢地）：只讀本句說得通（手指起皺的人做得比較慢），但前一句 Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things. 和下一句 Like the patterns on car tires, the wrinkles may help water flow away so that our fingers can hold on better. 都說皺紋有幫助，做得更慢就和這個說法相反。
option_notes_zh.B: nervously（緊張地）：研究比的是做事的表現，和緊張無關，說不通。
option_notes_zh.D: angrily（生氣地）：手指有沒有皺紋和生不生氣無關，說不通。

5.strategy_zh: 這個實驗是用來支持「皺紋有幫助」的說法，實驗結果要和前後文一致。
hints: 空格要填副詞，句型是 more＋adv.＋than。
前文：皺紋幫我們拿濕東西；下一句：手指抓得更牢。
有皺紋的人做得「更有效率」：efficiently。

translation_zh.text:
如果你在浴缸或游泳池裡待很久，可能會發現手指和腳趾的皮膚變得皺皺的。很多年來，人們以為這是因為皮膚吸了水、變大了。
不過在 1930 年代，醫生注意到一件奇怪的事：神經受損的手指即使泡水很久，也完全不會起皺。這顯示我們的神經在這個變化中扮演了角色。皮膚碰到水時，神經會讓皮膚底下的微血管變小。結果皮膚下面的空間變少，上面的皮膚就折成一條條細紋。
但身體為什麼要這麼做呢？有些科學家認為，皺紋能幫我們拿起濕的東西。在一項研究中，受試者要把濕的物品從一個盒子移到另一個盒子。手指起皺的人比手指光滑的人完成得更有效率。就像汽車輪胎上的紋路一樣，皺紋也許能讓水流走，讓手指抓得更牢。

evidence: Fingers with damaged nerves did not wrinkle at all, even after a long time in water.
This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change.
2.explanation_zh: 神經受損的手指不會起皺，顯示神經在變化中「扮演角色」；play a role in 為固定搭配。

evidence: Those with wrinkled fingers finished the task more [[5]] than those with smooth fingers.

evidence: For many years, people thought this happened [[1]] the skin simply took in water and grew bigger.
1.explanation_zh: 空格後是人們以為的原因（皮膚吸水變大），需要表原因的連接詞 because。

evidence: Fingers with damaged nerves did not wrinkle at all, even after a long time in water.
This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change.
2.explanation_zh: 神經受損就不起皺，表示神經在這個變化中扮演角色，play a role in 為固定用法。

evidence: When the skin gets wet, the nerves tell the tiny blood vessels under it to become [[3]].
As a result, there is less room under the skin, and the skin on top folds into small lines.

evidence: Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things.
Like the patterns on car tires, the wrinkles may help water flow away so that our fingers can hold on better.
4.explanation_zh: 皺紋像輪胎花紋讓手指抓得更牢，因此是幫助我們「拿起」濕的東西（pick up）。

evidence: Those with wrinkled fingers finished the task more [[5]] than those with smooth fingers.
Like the patterns on car tires, the wrinkles may help water flow away so that our fingers can hold on better.
5.explanation_zh: 皺紋有助抓握，所以手指起皺的人完成任務更「有效率」（efficiently）；其他選項與研究結論不合。

A.evidence: For many years, people thought this happened [[1]] the skin simply took in water and grew bigger.
A.explanation_zh: although（雖然）：後句是人們以為的起皺原因，不是讓步；「雖然皮膚吸水變大，還是起皺」前後不成讓步關係。

B.evidence: For many years, people thought this happened [[1]] the skin simply took in water and grew bigger.
B.explanation_zh: unless（除非）：變成「除非皮膚吸水變大才不起皺」，和要說明的原因正好相反。

C.evidence: For many years, people thought this happened [[1]] the skin simply took in water and grew bigger.
C.explanation_zh: until（直到）：表示時間界線，「起皺一直發生直到皮膚吸水」不合理；且下一段 however 推翻的是舊的原因說法。

A.evidence: This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change.
A.explanation_zh: play a trick 是「捉弄」，要接 on＋人，不能接 in the change；意思也不合。

C.evidence: This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change.
C.explanation_zh: play a song 是播放／演奏歌曲，和神經在皮膚變化中的作用無關。

D.evidence: This showed that our nerves play a [[2]] in the change.
D.explanation_zh: play a game 是玩遊戲，「神經在變化中玩遊戲」說不通。

A.evidence: As a result, there is less room under the skin, and the skin on top folds into small lines.
A.explanation_zh: wider（更寬的）：血管變寬，皮膚底下的東西變多，會把皮膚往外撐平（就像第一段被推翻的「吸水變大」），不會往內摺出細紋；皮膚會起皺，表示底下的體積變小、表面皮膚多出來才摺起來，只有血管變小說得通。

B.evidence: When the skin gets wet, the nerves tell the tiny blood vessels under it to become [[3]].
B.explanation_zh: louder（更大聲的）：血管不會發出聲音，說不通。

D.evidence: When the skin gets wet, the nerves tell the tiny blood vessels under it to become [[3]].
D.explanation_zh: funnier（更好笑的）：血管不會好笑，說不通。

B.evidence: Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things.
B.explanation_zh: write down（寫下）接文字或資訊，不能「寫下濕的東西」；下一句的實驗是移動濕物品。

C.evidence: Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things.
C.explanation_zh: turn off（關掉）用於電燈、機器，濕的東西不能被關掉。

D.evidence: Some scientists believe the wrinkles help us [[4]] wet things.
D.explanation_zh: look like（看起來像）：「皺紋幫我們看起來像濕的東西」說不通，也和下一句搬移濕物品的實驗無關。

A.evidence: Like the patterns on car tires, the wrinkles may help water flow away so that our fingers can hold on better.
A.explanation_zh: slowly（慢慢地）：上下文都說皺紋讓手指抓得更牢、對拿濕東西有幫助，起皺的人做得更慢和這個結論相反。

B.evidence: Those with wrinkled fingers finished the task more [[5]] than those with smooth fingers.
B.explanation_zh: nervously（緊張地）：研究比較的是搬東西的表現，和情緒無關，文中也沒有任何緊張的線索。

D.evidence: Those with wrinkled fingers finished the task more [[5]] than those with smooth fingers.
D.explanation_zh: angrily（生氣地）：手指有沒有皺紋和生氣無關，文中沒有任何相關線索。
